name: whisper-large-v3-turkish-general
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-10. Caveats: only 320 clips, all non-medical, self-collected; the card prints no harness details beyond WER/CER. This is the general-Turkish arm (M1) of a three-arm ablation - M2 (general+medical) scores 0.0795/0.0228, essentially tied. Values were printed as 0-1 fractions and converted to percent here; that conversion is stated in each config.
